objective: Extend the raw DR24 Workbench browser smoke to seven OIDs selected from five BTS-associated spatial candidate identifiers, and validate the sample manifest without approving physical-source grouping.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The five-OID smoke passed for 650 epochs in run 42232639126.
Four OIDs have independent HATS payload hashes; three additional candidate OIDs have availability-only evidence.
The DR24 BTS availability artifact includes OID 347104300029855 with 368 epochs and OID 725113200004086 with 1165 epochs.
These are spatial candidate associations, not confirmed physical identities.
The 50-row table cap is a maximum; shorter light curves display all available rows.

baseline.revision: PR #267 Workbench branch plus PR #272 five-OID smoke
baseline.description: Raw-only DR24 Explorer. No model, feature, taxonomy, benchmark, or release changes.

correctness.before: Five-OID browser smoke covered three BTS-associated candidate identifiers and 650 epochs.
correctness.after: Seven-OID browser workflow 42234667135 passed against the latest hardened adapter code copied from PR #264 head 8948f7af7dbb0a08c3a2454a8703276b6d2630b7. It returned and rendered 2183 epochs across five BTS-associated spatial candidate identifiers. Four OIDs matched independent HATS hashes; three OIDs passed availability, epoch-count, chart-count and SHA-256-format checks without independent payload-hash references.

reproducibility.before: Five-OID sample was not linked to a machine-readable candidate sample manifest.
reproducibility.after: Artifact 13511089199, ZIP SHA-256 c3abfad6b454a0433deee4e6792fff60653cf42d1c2e1244a2428c00b9f5b48d. Report records PR head 96b54aa4d5762b6fd881c32b2e0601647e2d61c9, base ed2ac91bf027b4081c727690ac0599acabe6f699, workflow revision 883a2abe02499d056b7070852b41522443866da5, per-OID counts, hashes, provenance and failure contracts. The test verifies the candidate manifest OID set, hash references, candidate-only status and totals.

reliability.after: Seven OIDs returned and rendered using the hardened adapter. Point counts were 78, 123, 216, 209, 24, 368 and 1165. Table rows were 50, 50, 50, 50, 24, 50 and 50. The null-catflags fixture rendered gray, not clean. Missing-OID and source-failure UI passed; no fallback was used.

scientific_validity.reason: Candidate spatial associations do not confirm physical identity. No OID grouping, photometry normalization, QC selection, feature generation, inference, calibration, OOD or anomaly evaluation is performed.

measurement.trade_off: Use seven OIDs across five BTS-associated candidate IDs. This is a raw lookup sample, not a confirmed five-object scientific sample. Three OIDs lack independent payload-hash references.

evidence: Seven-OID browser workflow 42234667135 passed on PR head 96b54aa4d5762b6fd881c32b2e0601647e2d61c9; base revision ed2ac91bf027b4081c727690ac0599acabe6f699; workflow revision 883a2abe02499d056b7070852b41522443866da5.
This run includes the latest hardened adapter code from PR #264 head 8948f7af7dbb0a08c3a2454a8703276b6d2630b7, including strict returned-OID validation and catalog/payload epoch-count validation.
All seven chart point counts matched epoch counts. Table rows were 50, 50, 50, 50, 24, 50 and 50, respecting the 50-row cap.

The first four canonical payload SHA-256 values matched independent HATS references. The last three have only availability evidence and recorded API hashes; they do not have independent payload-hash references.

The candidate manifest consistency checks passed: five unique BTS external IDs, seven OIDs, 2183 catalog epochs, exact OID set, exact independent-hash reference map, and candidate-only/no-grouping policy.
Synthetic catflags=null UI: PASS. The marker rendered gray (unknown), not blue (unflagged); the quality legend was visible.
Missing-OID UI: PASS. Source-failure UI: PASS. Silent ALeRCE fallback: false.
The five BTS external IDs are spatial candidates only. The test does not confirm physical identity or authorize OID grouping.
PR #264 strict adapter unit tests passed: 655 passed, 10 skipped, 9 warnings, 0 failures in run 42234083543. The 10 skipped tests remain unresolved.

root_causes: The first five-OID browser test failed because it expected 50 table rows for an OID with 24 epochs. The UI correctly rendered 24 rows. The assertion was corrected to min(50, epochs). The five-OID rerun and subsequent seven-OID runs passed.
unresolved: The last three OIDs still need independent payload-hash references.
The five BTS external IDs remain spatial candidates; physical-source identity is not confirmed.
No general OID-to-source grouping or identity acceptance has been established.
The full 5–10 object application acceptance test still requires a source-target workflow, descriptive QC, exports and a complete reproducibility bundle.

findings: The candidate manifest must keep OID identifiers separate from BTS external identifiers.
A spatial candidate match is not an approved cross-OID grouping rule.
A raw smoke can validate retrieval and display without claiming scientific identity.

open_blockers: Independently verify the payload hashes for the three OIDs without independent references.
Validate at least five astrophysical source targets with evidence-backed source identity before claiming the 5–10 object application acceptance test.
Add descriptive raw QC diagnostics that preserve all epochs and do not apply an unapproved quality mask.
Add catalog/report export and a complete reproducibility bundle.
Keep DR24 raw data separate from frozen v0.2.0 inference until time and photometry mapping are validated.
Complete the 30–50 object guided Park demonstration.

knowledge_carried_forward: Seven-OID raw Workbench smoke is verified for 2183 epochs; four payload hashes match independent HATS references and three do not have independent references.
The candidate manifest records five BTS spatial candidate IDs and seven OIDs, but it does not approve physical identity or grouping.
The 50-row table cap is a maximum; short light curves display all available rows.
Do not count OIDs as astrophysical objects.
Missing catflags are unknown, not clean.
Keep DR24 raw exploration separate from frozen v0.2.0 inference.
Do not filter catflags or relabel HMJD.
Do not claim Park MVP acceptance from this raw OID smoke.
